title: Laws of the iterated logarithm for random Dirichlet series with general weights
summary: For each $s>0$, we consider a random Dirichlet series $X(s)=\sum_{k\geq 1}k^{-1/2-s}a_kη_k$, where $η_1$, $η_2,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables with mean zero and finite positive variance, and $(a_k)_{k\geq 1}$ is a deterministic sequence of real numbers satisfying $\sum_{k\geq 1}k^{-1-2s}a_k^2 0$ and $\sum_{k\geq 1}k^{-1}a_k^2=\infty$. We investigate the almost-sure fluctuations of $X(s)$ as $s\to0+$.
